# Third-party Licenses

This directory lists license information and license texts for third-party components included in Peel release binaries. Build-only and development-only dependencies are not distributed and are not listed here.

This software is based in part on the work of the Independent JPEG Group. Bundled native libdeflate and mozjpeg/libjpeg license texts are included with their Rust wrapper entries.
